title: mentha aquatica var. crispa
intro: Mentha aquatica var. crispa, commonly known as curly watermint, is a variety of mint plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is used for its culinary and medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating digestive issues due to its health benefits of being a natural anti-inflammatory and carminative agent. The therapeutic actions of Mentha aquatica var. crispa include its ability to act as a natural expectorant, relieving respiratory issues such as coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
